notes.title: Patch v1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm Verebell, the developer.
I stopped updating due to personal reasons. But after a long time, I updated Clone War to version 1.2.0.

[b]- New Attribute Addition and Attribute Rework[/b]
We are introducing two new attributes: Defense and Additional Damage. The higher your Defense, the more damage from enemy attacks will be reduced. Meanwhile, Additional Damage allows you to deal damage that ignores the enemy's Defense entirely.
Additionally, as Jump Speed has been deemed less effective on its own, it has now been integrated into the Movement Speed attribute for better usability.
Take on the clones with these revamped attributes and dominate the battlefield!

[b]- Combat Item Balance Adjustment[/b]
With the recent attribute rework, the stat boosts provided by existing weapons have been adjusted. Additionally, we’ve introduced blue potions that enhance the new attributes and added a selection of new weapons.

[b]- Reward System Improvement[/b]
The reward distribution system has been improved, allowing players to now choose one item from three random rewards. Additionally, a fourth option has been introduced, enabling players to skip obtaining any item and proceed directly to the next stage.
Previously, if two weapons appeared as rewards while already possessing a weapon, it could feel disadvantageous. To address this, we have reduced the likelihood of such occurrences and added the skip feature to minimize dissatisfaction with the reward experience.

[b]- Combo Attack Balance Adjustment[/b]
We’ve received feedback that canceling combo attacks after the first or second hit was more efficient than executing the full sequence. To address this, we have increased the damage dealt by the final attack in a combo by 1.5 times.
Now, completing a combo attack will allow you to inflict significantly greater cumulative damage on your enemies.

[b]- Shop Improvement[/b]
You can now rotate the character by dragging with your mouse, allowing you to view characters and cosmetic items in greater detail.

[b]- New Statistics and Achievements Added[/b]
Players can now track new statistics, such as the number of gameplay sessions and total currency earned. Alongside these additions, new achievements have been introduced to match the updated statistics.

[b]- In addition, small bugs such as effect determination have been corrected.[/b]

Thank you for your interest in Clone War.
Weapon capabilities and combo attack damage can be adjusted later. Let me know if you'd like further adjustments or refinements!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm Verebell, the developer.
I updated Clone War to version 1.1.0 by reflecting the opinions of the users.

[b]- Improve the recovery of red potions [/b]
A red potion is an item that restores Hp to the absolute value. However, as the Max Hp increased, the probability of acquiring a red potion with a relatively low recovery amount increased, so there was a problem that it was less valuable than the demand.
Red potions now restore a certain amount of Hp based on Max Hp.
You may still be able to recover less Hp with a red potion, but even if your Max Hp increases, you will be able to recover the same percentage of Hp.

[b]- Add recovery function in case of Max Hp increase [/b]
Previously, even if the Max Hp increased, the current Hp remained the same as before, and as a result, it was judged that only the Max Hp increased, such as having to recover additional Hp, has a significantly lower value compared to other statistics.
Now, if your Max Hp rises with a blue potion, half of that figure is recovered. (It doesn't reflect on your Max Hp rise due to weapons.)
Max Hp will be a statistics that is important in the long term and right away.

[b]- Add graphic quality and mouse sensitivity settings[/b]
You can now adjust the graphics quality level and mouse sensitivity in option.

[b]- Help complements [/b]
We have made some modifications to the help.
It reflected content that is difficult to know depending on the propensity to play, such as action cancellation by jumping.

[b]- Improve enemy's spawning time [/b]
We decided that it would take too long for all enemies to spawn, so we shortened the time for them to spawn.
Now most enemies will be sponged right after the start of the stage.

[b]- Change the color of the enemy's Hp bar [/b]
I changed the color of the enemy's Hp bar to reflect the opinion that it is difficult to distinguish the player's Hp bar if there are many enemies.

[b]- Fixed other minor bugs. [/b]

Thank you for your interest in Clone War.

notes.title: Clone Wars is out now!
notes.notes:
You can now enjoy Clone War on Steam!

Clone Wars is a simple roguelike game by indie developer.
At first, it was a project to learn game development.
But I changed my mind and released this game on Steam for others to enjoy as well.
There are a lot of shortcomings, but I would appreciate it if you enjoy it.

The developer Verebell (V-Level Studio)
